title: What Closet Organization Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of closet organization: what it is and why getting it right pays off.

An organized closet saves 10+ minutes every morning. The method: empty everything, sort ruthlessly, zone by category, and maintain with a one-in-one-out rule.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Closet Organization
summary: Start closet organization this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Empty the entire closet
2. Sort into keep / donate / trash / relocate
3. Clean shelves and floor
4. Install zones: daily, work, formal, seasonal
5. Hang by category then color

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

Sort into keep / donate / trash / relocate
Clean shelves and floor
Install zones: daily, work, formal, seasonal
Hang by category then color

title: The Core Method for Closet Organization, Step by Step
summary: The complete closet organization method from start to finish.
body:
The full method:

Step 1: Empty the entire closet
Step 2: Sort into keep / donate / trash / relocate
Step 3: Clean shelves and floor
Step 4: Install zones: daily, work, formal, seasonal
Step 5: Hang by category then color
Step 6: Fold knits; never hang them (they stretch)

title: Closet Organization Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common closet organization questions.
body:
Q: How often to declutter?
A: Seasonally - 15 minutes, four times a year.

Q: What about sentimental items?
A: Keep a small memory box; not the whole closet.

Q: Small closet solutions?
A: Double-hang rods and over-door organizers.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
